title: Editor E0 task 12b, the member's own profile preview runs on the node grid behind render_path_space_profile
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. OwnerProfileLayoutPreview renders LiveNodeGrid (now takes kind, default space) seeded from ownerNodeLayout(grid, {}, 'member') only while render_path_space_profile is on, and LiveProfileGrid otherwise. Switch off: no change. Next: the importer's member node layouts, then the marketing and site surfaces and the task 15 backfill.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/profile/owner-profile-layout-preview.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!s.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('space_profile')\"))bad.push('preview not behind the switch');if(!s.includes('LiveNodeGrid'))bad.push('no node grid');if(!s.includes('LiveProfileGrid'))bad.push('legacy grid dropped');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/live-node-grid.tsx','utf8').includes('resolveNodeRows(layout, kind)'))bad.push('grid ignores kind');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1064: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the owner preview serves the node grid without the switch or LiveNodeGrid stops honouring kind. Behavior is live-node-grid.test.tsx.
